examples.ko: 기부한 사람들의 이름을 금액 순서대로 널판에 써 붙였어요.
examples.en: They wrote the donors' names on a board in order of amount.
My father cut a board and made a shelf.

examples.ko: 비가 와서 널판 위로 걸어서 건넜어요.
examples.en: It had rained, so we crossed by walking over a board.

examples.ko: 창고 문에 널판을 대서 구멍을 막았어요.
examples.en: I put a board over the hole in the warehouse door.

examples.ko: 공사장 입구에 널판이 길게 놓여 있어요.
examples.en: Long boards are laid at the entrance to the construction site.

examples.ko: 이 널판은 두껍고 단단해서 책상으로 쓰기 좋아요.
examples.en: This board is thick and sturdy, so it works well as a desk.

explain: 넓고 얇게 켠 나무 조각을 말해요. 같은 뜻으로 '널빤지'도 있는데, 일상 대화에서는 '널빤지'를 더 많이 써요. 비슷한 말로 '판자'도 있어요.

phrases.en: I laid planks on the floor.
phrases.nuance_ko: 같은 뜻이고 일상 대화에서는 이쪽을 더 많이 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Same meaning, and more common in everyday talk.

phrases.en: I blocked the window by nailing a board over it.
phrases.nuance_ko: '판자'는 나무판을 가리키는 더 짧은 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A shorter word for a wooden board.

phrases.example: 저는 널판 한 장을 사 왔어요.
phrases.en: I bought one board.
phrases.nuance_ko: 숫자를 세는 말 '장'과 함께 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A collocation with the counter 장.

explain_en: It means a wide, thin cut piece of wood. '널빤지' means the same and is more common in everyday talk. '판자' is a similar word.

examples.en: I chose a light-colored wallpaper.

examples.ko: 이 도배지는 물걸레로 닦을 수 있어요.
examples.en: You can wipe this wallpaper with a damp cloth.

examples.ko: 벽에 곰팡이가 생겨서 도배지를 새로 붙여야 해요.
examples.en: Mold grew on the wall, so we have to put up new wallpaper.

examples.ko: 도배지 샘플을 몇 개 받아 왔어요.
examples.en: I got a few wallpaper samples.

examples.ko: 낡은 도배지가 뜯어져서 보기 안 좋아요.
examples.en: The old wallpaper is peeling off and looks bad.
The wallpaper pattern is too flashy, so I'm hesitating.

explain: '벽지'와 거의 같은 뜻으로 쓰여요. 집을 고치거나 이사할 때 '도배하다, 도배지를 고르다'처럼 도배 작업과 함께 자주 나와요. 도배 작업은 보통 전문 업체에 맡겨요.

phrases.en: I changed the living room wallpaper.
phrases.nuance_ko: '도배지'와 거의 같은 뜻으로, 일상에서 더 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Almost the same as '도배지', but more common in daily talk.

phrases.en: I'm going to change the wallpaper before moving in.
phrases.nuance_ko: 집을 새로 꾸밀 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when redecorating a home.

phrases.en: The worker is putting wallpaper on the wall.
phrases.nuance_ko: 도배 작업을 하는 모습을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Describes the act of wallpapering.

explain_en: It is used almost the same as '벽지' (wallpaper). When people renovate or move, it appears together with the job itself, as in '도배하다' and '도배지를 고르다'. The work is usually left to a professional company.

examples.en: I use liquid soap when I wash my hands.
We've run out of liquid soap in the bathroom.
Liquid soap lathers well, so it's convenient.
I bought a liquid soap refill at the mart.
Can I wash dishes with liquid soap?
One drop of liquid soap is enough.

explain: 딱딱한 '비누'와 달리 액체로 되어 있고 펌프 용기에 담아 쓰는 비누예요. 손 씻는 용도로는 '핸드워시'라고도 말해요.

phrases.en: I washed my hands clean with liquid soap.
phrases.nuance_ko: '-로'를 붙여 수단으로 쓰는 흔한 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A common phrase using '-로' to show what you use.

phrases.en: I pressed the pump and squeezed out some liquid soap.
phrases.nuance_ko: 용기에서 비누를 꺼내 쓸 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when getting soap out of a container.

phrases.en: I put one more hand wash in the kitchen.
phrases.nuance_ko: 손 씻는 물비누를 부르는 외래어예요.
phrases.nuance_en: A loanword for liquid soap used for washing hands.

explain_en: Unlike a hard bar of '비누', it is liquid and usually comes in a pump bottle. For hand washing, people also say '핸드워시'.

examples.en: The child runs around holding a pinwheel.
When the wind blows, the pinwheel spins round and round.
A pinwheel doesn't spin without wind.
The child stopped in front of the pinwheel shop.
The garden decorated with pinwheels is pretty.
It's a dance that spins round and round like a pinwheel.

explain: 바람을 받아 빙글빙글 도는 장난감이에요. '바람개비를 돌리다'나 '바람개비가 돌다'처럼 말해요. 크게 만들어 놓은 풍력 발전기를 귀엽게 '바람개비'라고 부르기도 해요.

phrases.en: The child laughs while spinning a pinwheel.
phrases.nuance_ko: 사람이 바람개비를 돌게 할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when a person makes the pinwheel spin.

phrases.en: I made a pinwheel out of paper.
phrases.nuance_ko: 종이로 직접 만드는 놀이를 말할 때 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often used for the paper craft activity.

phrases.en: A pinwheel spins round and round by the window.
phrases.nuance_ko: 바람 때문에 저절로 도는 모습을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Describes it spinning by itself in the wind.

explain_en: It is a toy that spins around when wind catches it. You say '바람개비를 돌리다' or '바람개비가 돌다'. People sometimes also affectionately call a big wind turbine a '바람개비'.

examples.en: This tumbler keeps heat well.
In winter you need to pay attention to keeping warm.
I put hot soup in an insulated lunch box.
I bought long underwear with a good warming effect.

examples.ko: 아기 방은 보온을 위해 창문에 뽁뽁이를 붙였어요.
examples.en: For warmth, I put bubble wrap on the baby room's window.

examples.ko: 엄마가 보온병에 차를 가득 담아 주셨어요.
examples.en: Mom filled a thermos with tea for me.

explain: 따뜻함을 지킨다는 말이라서 차갑게 지키는 '보냉'과 짝이에요. '보온병', '보온 도시락', '보온 효과'처럼 뒤에 다른 말을 붙일 때가 많고 '보온이 잘 되다'로 써요.

phrases.en: I put hot tea in the thermos.
phrases.nuance_ko: 따뜻함을 오래 지켜 주는 병이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A bottle that keeps liquid warm for a long time.

phrases.en: Thick curtains have a heat-insulating effect.
phrases.nuance_ko: 따뜻함을 지키는 효과를 설명할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to explain the effect of keeping warmth in.

phrases.en: I put the drinks in a cooler bag.
phrases.nuance_ko: 보온의 짝말이고, 차가움을 지킨다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The counterpart of 보온; it means keeping things cold.

explain_en: '보온' is about keeping heat in, and its pair is '보냉', keeping things cold. It is often followed by another word, as in '보온병', '보온 도시락' and '보온 효과', and you say '보온이 잘 되다'.

examples.ko: 빨래가 햇볕에 하루 만에 뽀송뽀송 말랐어요.
examples.en: The laundry dried fresh and fluffy in the sun in a day.
The blanket out of the dryer is dry and cozy.

examples.ko: 제습기를 켜 놓으면 방이 뽀송뽀송 마르는 느낌이에요.
examples.en: With the dehumidifier on, the room feels nicely dry.

examples.ko: 샤워를 하고 나서 머리를 뽀송뽀송 말렸어요.
examples.en: After showering, I dried my hair until it was soft and dry.

examples.ko: 장마가 끝나니 세탁물이 뽀송뽀송 잘 말라요.
examples.en: Now that the rainy season is over, laundry dries nicely.
The baby's face is soft, fresh and white, and so cute.

explain: '보송보송'의 센말이라 둘 다 쓸 수 있어요. 젖었다가 잘 마른 빨래나 이불, 부드러운 피부처럼 산뜻하게 마른 느낌이고, 반대는 '눅눅하다, 축축하다'예요.

phrases.en: The blanket dried soft and dry in the sun.
phrases.nuance_ko: '뽀송뽀송'보다 조금 순한 느낌이고 뜻은 같아요.
phrases.nuance_en: Has a slightly milder feel than 뽀송뽀송 but the same meaning.

phrases.en: The laundry dried soft and fluffy in the dryer.
phrases.nuance_ko: 젖은 것이 산뜻하게 마르는 모습에 자주 붙여 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often used for something wet drying out fresh and fluffy.

phrases.en: I dried the towel in the sun until it was soft and dry.
phrases.nuance_ko: 젖은 것을 산뜻하게 마르도록 말릴 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when you dry something wet until it ends up fresh and dry.
phrases.en_equiv: to dry until soft and dry

explain_en: It is the stronger form of '보송보송', and both can be used. It describes a fresh, dry feel, like well-dried laundry, blankets or soft skin, and the opposites are '눅눅하다' and '축축하다'.

examples.en: I changed the room lighting to a warm color.
If the indoor lighting is dim, my eyes get tired.
I like this cafe because the lighting is soft.
The photo came out yellow because of the indoor lighting.

examples.ko: 공부방 실내조명은 너무 밝지 않게 하세요.
examples.en: Don't make the lighting in the study room too bright.
I picked out the room lighting myself in the new house.

explain: 집이나 가게 안의 불빛을 말하고, 인테리어 이야기에서 자주 나와요. 그냥 '조명'이라고 해도 대부분 통해요. '실내조명이 밝다/어둡다/은은하다'처럼 분위기를 표현할 때도 써요.

phrases.en: Thanks to the soft indoor lighting, the atmosphere is nice.
phrases.nuance_ko: 조명이 부드럽고 편안하다고 분위기를 칭찬할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to praise a soft, comfortable atmosphere created by the lighting.

phrases.en: I went into the room and turned on the lights.
phrases.nuance_ko: 불을 켠다는 뜻이고, 일상 대화에서는 그냥 '불을 켜다'라고 더 많이 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means turning on the lights; in daily talk '불을 켜다' is more common.
phrases.en_equiv: to turn on the room lights

phrases.en: The lighting in this shop is too bright.
phrases.nuance_ko: '실내조명'을 짧게 줄인 말로, 대부분 같은 뜻으로 통해요.
phrases.nuance_en: A shorter form of '실내조명' that works in most situations.

explain_en: It refers to the lighting inside a home or shop and comes up in interior design talk. Just saying '조명' usually works too. It is also used to describe atmosphere, as in '실내조명이 밝다/어둡다/은은하다'.

examples.en: I bought a bookshelf kit and put it together myself.

examples.ko: 이 침대는 조립식이라서 이사할 때 편해요.
examples.en: This bed is the assembly type, so it is convenient when moving.

examples.ko: 방을 조립식으로 만들면 빨리 지을 수 있어요.
examples.en: If you build the room as a prefab, you can finish it quickly.
I bought it without knowing it was self-assembly and had a hard time.

examples.ko: 조립식은 값이 싸지만 튼튼하지 않을 때도 있어요.
examples.en: Assembly-type items are cheap but sometimes not sturdy.
These days even self-assembly furniture has pretty designs.

explain: 부품을 사서 직접 맞춰 만드는 방식을 말해서 '조립식 가구', '조립식 주택'처럼 뒤의 명사를 꾸며요. 반대로 이미 다 만들어진 상태로 파는 것은 '완제품'이라고 해요. '조립식이다'처럼 서술어로도 써요.

phrases.en: I bought self-assembly furniture when I moved.
phrases.nuance_ko: 직접 맞춰 만드는 가구를 말할 때 가장 흔히 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: This is the most common way to refer to furniture you assemble yourself.

phrases.example: 조립식 주택은 빨리 지을 수 있어요.
phrases.en: A prefab house can be built quickly.
phrases.nuance_ko: 공장에서 만든 부품으로 짓는 집을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: It refers to a house built from factory-made parts.

phrases.example: 이 책상은 조립식이 아니라서 바로 쓸 수 있어요.
phrases.en: This desk isn't self-assembly, so you can use it right away.
phrases.nuance_ko: 서술어로 써서 이미 완성된 제품인지 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used as a predicate, it says the product is already assembled.

explain_en: It describes things you put together from parts, and it modifies a noun that follows, as in '조립식 가구' or '조립식 주택'. The opposite, something sold already assembled, is a '완제품'. You can also use it as a predicate: '조립식이다'.

en: to be adjusted; to be regulated

examples.en: The air conditioner temperature is adjusted automatically.
The volume was adjusted with a button.
Prices will be controlled by government policy.
It is a self-adjusting chair, so it is comfortable.
My blood pressure is well controlled with medicine.
The light is adjusted, so my eyes are less tired.

explain: 온도, 소리, 속도, 양을 알맞은 정도로 맞출 때 써요. '조정하다'는 시간이나 기준을 바꾸는 일이고, '조종하다'는 비행기나 기계를 직접 움직이는 일이라서 서로 달라요. 사람이 하면 '조절하다', 저절로 맞춰지면 '조절되다'예요.

phrases.en: The volume doesn't adjust well.
phrases.nuance_ko: 표제어의 부정형이에요. 기계나 몸이 원하는 대로 맞춰지지 않을 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The negative form. Use it when a machine or the body won't adjust the way you want.

phrases.en: I bought a chair that adjusts automatically.
phrases.nuance_ko: 뒤 명사를 꾸며 줘요. 제품을 설명할 때 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: It modifies the noun that follows. Common when describing products.

phrases.en: The room temperature is adjusted to a good level.
phrases.nuance_ko: '알맞게'를 붙이면 적당한 정도로 맞춰진다는 뜻이 분명해져요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adding '알맞게' makes it clear that something is set to a suitable level.

explain_en: Used when temperature, sound, speed or amount is set to a suitable level. '조정하다' changes a schedule or standard, and '조종하다' means operating a plane or machine, so they differ. A person does '조절하다'; when it adjusts by itself it is '조절되다'.

dis.h: be adjusted to a suitable level

p.n: 제어되다 sounds more technical and stresses control, not setting a level.

examples.en: The coating on this frying pan has peeled off.
If you laminate paper, it does not get wet.
I laminated my student ID and have used it for a long time.
A laminated menu is easy to wipe clean.
Coating wears off over time.
Thanks to the shiny coating, the photo lasts long.

explain: 물건 이야기에서 '코팅이 벗겨지다', '코팅하다'로 자주 써요. 같은 일을 '입히다'로 풀어 말할 수도 있지만 대화에서는 보통 '코팅'을 그대로 써요. 머리나 손톱 관리 이야기에서도 '코팅한다'고 해요.

phrases.en: We laminate the menu.
phrases.nuance_ko: 표면에 얇은 막을 입히는 행동을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: The action of putting a thin protective layer on a surface.

phrases.en: The pot's coating peeled off, so I bought a new one.
phrases.nuance_ko: 주방 도구 이야기에서 자주 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A common phrase when talking about kitchen tools.

phrases.example: 이 책 표지는 코팅이 되어 있어요.
phrases.en: This book cover is laminated.
phrases.nuance_ko: 이미 코팅된 상태를 설명할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Describes something that is already coated.

explain_en: For objects you often hear '코팅이 벗겨지다' (the coating peels) and '코팅하다'. It could be described with '입히다', but in conversation people just say '코팅'. It also appears in hair and nail care.

examples.en: The communication network went down because of the typhoon.
A new network was installed, and the internet got faster.

examples.ko: 이 지역은 통신망이 약해서 전화가 잘 안 돼요.
examples.en: The network is weak in this area, so calls often fail.
The company overhauled its communication network.

examples.ko: 통신망 공사 때문에 오전에 연결이 안 됐어요.
examples.en: The connection failed in the morning due to network work.
It is hard to connect to the network in the mountains.

explain: '네트워크'와 뜻이 비슷하지만 '통신망'은 전화나 인터넷처럼 연결된 통신 설비를 말해서 조금 더 공식적이에요. '통신망이 끊기다', '통신망이 복구되다'처럼 뉴스에 자주 나와요.

phrases.en: The communication network was restored in a day.
phrases.nuance_ko: 끊겼던 통신이 다시 연결될 때 뉴스에서 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often used in the news when cut-off service comes back.

phrases.example: 시골 마을에도 새 통신망을 깔고 있어요.
phrases.en: They are laying a new communication network even in the countryside.
phrases.nuance_ko: 선이나 설비를 설치해서 연결할 때 '깔다'를 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: 깔다 is used for installing lines or equipment to connect.

phrases.example: 이동 통신망이 약해서 전화가 잘 안 돼요.
phrases.en: The mobile network is weak, so calls don't go through well.
phrases.nuance_ko: 휴대폰이 쓰는 통신망을 따로 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to talk specifically about the network phones use.

explain_en: It is close to 네트워크, but 통신망 refers to the connected telecom infrastructure such as phone and internet lines, and sounds a bit more official. In the news you hear '통신망이 끊기다' and '통신망이 복구되다'.
